price_basis: 2026-09-10 API Standard equivalent, known usage only; not actual billing
episode_unit: one attempted episode; not one video frame or training-ready record
wallclock_note: episode end timestamps were not recorded; no inference+simulation substitution
output_interval_definition: mean interval between parsed candidate returns = (last(started_at+elapsed_s)-first(started_at+elapsed_s))/(number_of_candidates-1); includes execution and preparation between returns, no fixed Hz
observation_interval_definition: (last observation sim_time_s - first)/(saved RGB sets-1); includes repeated-time observations on failed/rejected requests; not uniform sampling
